decision: Retain the DOS 6.0-identical high-memory variables and access macros.
evidence: The source matches DOS 6.0 and astro byte for byte.
BIOS SYSCONF and COMMAND RDATA, STUB and LOADHI include highvar.inc; conditional macros select definitions or external declarations.
The previous LOADHI comparison matched 1697 non-relocation bytes and 73 internal branches at an inferred target location (review 128).
The RDATA pre-message OMF comparison matched 470 non-relocation bytes and compared 356 unrecorded bytes to a linked reference after alignment; 66 relocation bytes remain unresolved (review 137).
limitations: The unrecorded RDATA comparison is not semantic proof of uninitialized data, and target data base is inferred. These comparisons do not validate every conditional definition or final addresses; complete core binary identity remains unverified.
